summary: iter90av backend + frontend testing done. All 8 pytest cases in test_iter90av_syndic_config.py PASS (crypto roundtrip, syndic self config GET/PUT, manager inherits parent config, encrypted secret storage with enc:v1: prefix + masked in GET, complete-onboarding validation 400/200, test-email 400/500 fallback, admin list+edit+403 for gestionnaire, logo upload PNG->GridFS + GET bytes). Auth guards verified: /api/syndic-config/me and /api/admin/syndic-config/list return 401 without auth. Finlead Properties preseeded correctly (legal_name='Finlead Properties', email=welcome@goodexperienceproperties.be) visible in admin list. PDF e2e regression: GET /api/reports/situation-compte/{owner_id}/pdf?copropriete_id=X returns valid PDF (bytes start with %PDF, 2815 bytes). Frontend /admin/syndic-config loads, shows 4 syndics with badges (Logo/Onboarding/Config email), Editer opens dialog-syndic-detail pre-filled with legal_name/email; all admin-* testids present. SyndicOnboardingWizard renders automatically for fresh syndic (onboarding-wizard visible + 5 step indicators + onboarding-input-logo + onboarding-btn-next detected).

integration_issues.issue: Sur un nouveau syndic, deux modaux se superposent apres acceptation CGU/RGPD: le 'Bienvenue sur CoproManager' welcome tour (Etape 1/6) apparait par-dessus le SyndicOnboardingWizard (Bienvenue ! Configurez votre cabinet syndic). Le SyndicOnboardingWizard est bien monte (data-testid=onboarding-wizard, 5 step indicators, tous les champs step1 presents) mais l'utilisateur doit fermer/traverser le welcome tour avant de pouvoir interagir avec le wizard cabinet.

issues: DialogContent sans DialogTitle -> warning a11y console (deja present avant iter90av mais l'edit dialog l'aggrave)

action_items: Coordonner l'affichage entre welcome tour (Bienvenue sur CoproManager) et SyndicOnboardingWizard: soit skip le welcome tour quand role=syndic + onboarding_completed=false, soit rendre le wizard cabinet apres cloture du tour.
Ajouter un DialogTitle (ou VisuallyHidden) dans AdminSyndicConfigPage dialog pour supprimer le warning a11y.
